sections.value: Public core contracts, real source inspection/provider seams and SDK query/discovery semantics are implemented and exercised with supplied/native synthetic evidence; this does not yet claim installed CLI composition. Core/adapter/loader/SDK edge cases plus a throwaway external SDK discovery smoke; full installed CLI/recipe acceptance is phase3. Output/docs can be authored concurrently in guide wave1; phase gates are outcome checkpoints, not a reason to serialize independent source work.

value.title: PM query contract baseline and shared-file ownership
value.success: Implement the real minimal core DTO/port/schema/error/action/limit contracts and fixture/fakes before coder release. Own shared manifests, lockfile and architecture policy throughout convergence; freeze and review exported signatures, not a stub query implementation.
value.notes: Guide unit: tk-0001; wave 0; owner role pm. Exact paths/reads/interfaces/dependencies: ../../impl-guide.dd.json#units/tk-0001. Approved decomposition receipt: ../../team/review-decomposition-approved.dd.json. Phase1 baseline; no future implementation SHA is required for guide approval. Workers receive committed contracts/fakes through live Builder map-first packets after review and baseline proof. Canonical plan/guide/flow/receipt files are PM-only. Mandatory R3 wave0 followups: ../../baseline-followups.json; implement the closed CursorMismatchReason and inspect C21/C22/C23/C25 before sealing. Guide approval is not baseline approval. Scoped decomposition approval is recorded; the explicit operator role amendment is in ../../team/operator-role-amendment.json. No coder dispatch is issued by this dossier. A compile or coder completion claim is not acceptance.

value.title: Claude and Codex query facts
value.success: Share existing JSON decode/classification; implement QueryAdapter for the existing adapter types. Preserve explicit header/session/turn/part evidence, user versus tool-result/context/summary distinction, call identity, clocks and source-qualified usage; keep existing OTLP map output and partition invariance unchanged.

value.title: VS Code document and journal query facts
value.success: Reuse journal::reduce then versioned request/response containment and serialized tool facts. Preserve current-revision provenance and unsupported fields; completion/confirmation is not execution success. Author only evidence-backed workspace association metadata handling, never infer a workspace hash as cwd.

value.title: Cursor transcript and IDE query facts
value.success: Reuse transcript classifiers and IDE key/composer/header validation. Keep idless/timeless/result-less transcript facts unavailable; IDE main-spine order is authoritative, global stores are mixed-project, and missing/orphan/alternate branch evidence is explicit. No blob-store decoder or opaque payload guess.

value.title: Bounded local discovery and input provider
value.success: Implement explicit local QuerySource composition from injected registrations/roots/stdin, bounded native source snapshots, revision observation and repository metadata transport. Reuse JSONL/snapshot readers; SDK retains association/selection semantics. Provide all absence/unreadable/unassociated/unsupported categories without hidden HOME recursion or remote enrichment.

value.title: Coherent SDK query engine
value.success: Implement QueryService, immutable QueryView and all six typed datasets, evidence-qualified identity/lineage/turn/call reconstruction, shared filters/time/order/pagination, context selection, projection and statistics. Keep this mutually coupled semantic core under one owner instead of independent noun handlers. Enforce limits and return semantic next actions and typed recoveries.
value.notes: Guide unit: tk-0008; wave 1; owner role coder. Exact paths/reads/interfaces/dependencies: ../../impl-guide.dd.json#units/tk-0008. Approved decomposition receipt: ../../team/review-decomposition-approved.dd.json. Real source facts are supplied by baseline fixtures/fakes, not sibling imports. Public manifest dependencies are PM-owned. Keep permanent tests for actual ambiguous/boundary/error/transition risks, not forwarding/default assertions. Skip validation while concurrent. Ordered internal proof milestones against bp-0008: M1 admitted scope/schema/source-session identity; M2 message/event/turn/tool graph; M3 predicates/time/order/cursor freshness; M4 privacy/context/offline completeness; M5 stats/usage/actions/errors. Each has its own observable case group and progress receipt at PM validation; only the fully implemented unit is delivered, never a stub milestone. Multiple unambiguous session/branch groups are valid context input. C25 proof distinguishes immutable view identity from current request/output metadata: page size/available columns do not alter view digest; source selection/revision/retention do. Never hash or mutate a ResultUniverse back-reference inside the view. PM quality acceptance is mandatory: candidate code is inspected for correctness, maintainability and needless allocations/duplication, exercised through applicable composed behavior and independently reviewed. A compile or coder completion claim is not acceptance.

tk-0001.assertion: The complete C21-C23 DTO/schema/fake freeze set distinguishes typed source facts, available/null/absent fields, source selection, recovery and saved-universe completeness, and is independently reviewed at its actual committed baseline before wave1.
The shared field registry and projection contract identify sensitive payloads, including recursively nested fields; raw observation types are not an output serialization path.
Invalid or overflowing limits and incompatible request combinations fail before source/output calls.
Semantic next actions and typed recoveries can represent success, zero matches, partial data and every declared error without embedding raw private input.
The actual committed core contract/fixture/fake baseline passes its declared checks and has an independent exact-basis review before coder release.

StaleCursor exposes a closed QueryOptionsChanged versus SourceViewChanged reason to SDK/CLI consumers; query binding is compared before view binding and malformed tokens are not mislabeled source changes.

tk-0002.assertion: Claude/Codex source facts retain native identifiers, locators, clocks and query-relevant metadata without changing OTLP mapping.
Tool-result-only and injected/control/summary records do not become duplicate initiating user requests.
Only explicit native call/turn links and outcomes become pairing evidence; unmatched or absent facts remain unavailable.
Supported content is retained only under the supplied access policy and no opaque/sidecar data is silently followed.

tk-0003.assertion: Explicit session/header/parent/branch facts remain distinct from an invented active leaf or parent-session traversal.
Compaction, summaries and toolResult roles cannot create initiating user turns.
Call/result references and native message/entry clocks remain separately qualified; assistant durations never become tool durations.
Hidden/opaque provider, media and reference payloads are not re-emitted by query inspection.

tk-0004.assertion: Current native context changes preserve repository association evidence rather than labeling a whole mixed stream from one cwd.
Legacy chat and timeline preserve their distinct revision-qualified source views and unavailable clocks.
Request/start/completion/progress facts preserve explicit IDs and success/cancellation evidence without adjacency pairing.
Content and diagnostics follow the same safe policy as other registered formats.

tk-0005.assertion: Document and journal inputs produce the same final logical request/response state with exact representation/revision provenance.
Request/response containment is distinguished from journal operations, deleted history and absent responses.
Serialized invocation completeness/confirmation is never mislabeled execution success.
Workspace directory hints are not promoted to native repository association without a supported tested metadata join.

tk-0006.assertion: Idless/timeless/result-less transcript evidence remains unavailable rather than reconstructed from filenames or adjacency.
IDE composer/header/key agreement controls identity; missing/orphan/conflicting rows are explicit.
Only the validated native conversation ordering/boundaries support higher-level episodes; unknown branches remain unclaimed.
Mixed global stores and lossy project-path encodings cannot leak unrelated repository evidence into a query.

tk-0007.assertion: Registered exact/tree/worktree discovery rejects sibling prefixes and distinguishes absent, unreadable, unsupported, conflicting and unassociated sources.
Bounded source views detect mid-read/equal-size changes and carry the revision needed to reject stale continuations.
Source, byte, record and expansion limits refuse without silent truncation or source mutation.
Offline input loading is explicit and never performs hidden live discovery/enrichment.

tk-0008.assertion: Copies, reused IDs, participant identities, fork prefixes and unresolved conflicts yield consistent logical rows across list/tree/extract/stats.
Typed repeated-value/field/operator/null/pattern filters select the intended rows and do not echo inspected content.
Half-open UTC event windows work inside older sessions, with explicit undated handling and no file-mtime fallback.
Stable unknown-last sorting and query/view-bound continuation neither skip nor duplicate rows after source changes.
Source-supported initiating requests create stable branch-qualified turn membership; unresolved control fragments remain events.
Scoped native-ID pairing preserves retries, progress, ambiguity, cancellations, missing completions and invalid clocks.
Stats equal reductions of the matched exported rows, with measured/missing/basis/outcome denominators and no cumulative/replay double counting.
Context expands independently within admitted session/branch groups, merges overlap and labels out-of-window context without widening repository/content authority.
Saved-input queries distinguish unavailable fields and incomplete row universes from empty evidence; no fabricated context or live reads.
A real external SDK caller obtains the same typed selection/error/projection semantics without invoking the CLI.
Continuation failures distinguish changed query options from changed source/view evidence using the baseline's closed CursorMismatchReason, with no private value echoed.

Actual QueryService/QueryView calls prove C25: limit and available-column changes retain the source-view digest; creating/changing response universe, action or cursor cannot feed back into it; source revision, admission selection or retained capability changes alter it. Prove via crates/sdk/tests/query.rs under guide check bp-0008; baseline type-exclusion and fixed-vector proof do not satisfy this runtime obligation.

value.approach: Use each assertion's selected pressure and the exact guide check; no unexecuted test or imported commit is runtime proof.
value.phase_boundary: Core/adapter/loader/SDK edge cases plus a throwaway external SDK discovery smoke; full installed CLI/recipe acceptance is phase3. Output/docs can be authored concurrently in guide wave1; phase gates are outcome checkpoints, not a reason to serialize independent source work.
value.concurrency: No build/test/lint/formatter while concurrent edits are in flight; PM executes final composed lanes and targeted fixes.
value.proof_grades: Existing boot proves native projections only. BUILD/EXTEND checks must be implemented and run before assertions become checked.
